mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET del_flag = 1, role_key = CONCAT(role_key, '#del_', role_id), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.data_scope, r.status, r.del_flag FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.del_flag = 0
